description: Facet is a library of Roblox UI controls written in Luau. It uses Compose for reactive state, composition, and resource ownership. Native Roblox layout, input, and StyleSheets provide engine behavior. Facet supplies controls, themes, and author tools. MIT licensed; the license travels inside the package under Facet.Distribution.LICENSE. Source, documentation, and issue tracker: the Facet repository on GitHub.
